pageContent: The history of artificial intelligence (AI) dates back to the mid-20th century, when the term was first coined by computer scientist John McCarthy in 1956. The field has since grown rapidly, with significant advancements in machine learning, natural language processing, and computer vision. One of the earliest milestones in AI was the development of the first neural network, the perceptron, by Frank Rosenblatt in 1957.
